ov: Yaesu FTDX10 Compact HF/50 MHz 100 W SDR Transceiver The exciting Yaesu FTDX10 Compact HF/50 MHz 100 W SDR Transceiver utilizes the Yaesu Hybrid SDR configuration - Narrow Band SDR and Direct Sampling SDR - like the FTDX101 series. The Narrow band SDR receiver emphasizes excellent receiver performance, while the Direct Sampling SDR provides a Digital Processing Real-Time Spectrum Scope with external monitor output.Main Features of the Yaesu FTDX10 Compact HF/50 MHz 100W SDR Transceiver:- Narrow Band SDR with 3 types of roofing filters and phenomenal multi-signal receiving characteristics, as in the FTDX-101 series. The Down Conversion type receiver configuration with the first IF at 9 MHz has been adopted for the FTDX10. Excellent narrow bandwidth crystal roofing filters have the desired sharp “cliff edge” shape factor. Thanks to the Narrow Band SDR’s latest circuit configuration including 500 Hz, 3 kHz and 12 kHz roofing filters and low-noise oscillator, the RMDR (Reciprocal Mixing Dynamic Range) reaches 116 dB or more, the close-in BDR (Blocking Dynamic Range) reaches 141 dB or more and 3rd IMDR (third-order Intermodulation Dynamic Range) reaches 109 dB or more in the 14 MHz band at 2 kHz separation.- 250MHz HRDDS (High Resolution Direct Digital Synthesizer) affords quiet and clear reception The local circuit of the new FTDX10 uses 250MHz HRDDS method same as the FTdx-101 series. Thanks to its characteristics that improve the C/N (carrier to noise) ratio and the careful selection of components in the design, the phase noise characteristic of the local signal achieves an excellent value of -145 dB or less in 14 MHz at 2 kHz separation.- 3DSS (3-Dimensional Spectrum Stream) on the 5-inch Full-Color TFT Display with Touch-Panel functionality The 5-inch Full-Color panel shows the 3DSS display. By touching the frequency display, the numeric keypad is displayed and the active band and frequency adjustment can be set by direct input. Frequency setting and adjustment can also be performed by turning the MAIN dial or touching the scope display. Similar to the FTdx-101 series, the MULTI display, RX operation status display, Center, FIX and Cursor modes are available.-

TX band coverage includes HF 160 – 10M, with the addition of 6M, 2M, and 70cm. The Yaesu FTX-1 Field is perfect for portable field operation. This model features up to 10W of power output when used with an external 13.8VDC power supply. By attaching the SBR-52LI Li-ion to the rear of the Field Head, the FTX-1 provides 6W (5W for QRP) stand-alone operation on HF through V/UHF bands in all modes – SSB, CW, AM, FM and C4FM digital. 9-hour stand-alone operating time with 6W on HF bands (SSB), and 8-hour operating time with 6W on V/UHF bands (FM) are available (6-6-48 duty cycle). By connecting the power amplifier to the back of the Field Head—without any tools—you can instantly upgrade the FTX-1 into a powerful 100W base or portable transceiver when using an external 13.8VDC power supply.The Optima is capable of low-power operation at 6W (5W QRP). ov: Yaesu FT-3185R VHF FM Mobile Transceivers Yaesu FT-3185R VHF FM Mobile Transceivers are powerful mobile transceivers designed for the 2-meter amateur band, offering up to 85W of power with additional selectable power settings of 50W, 20W or 5W. Its massive heatsink, which operates without a cooling fan, ensures consistent RF power output. Essential features include CTCSS/DCS encode/decode, Automatic Power-Off (APO), Time-Out Timer (TOT), and Automatic Repeater Shift (ARS), making the FT-3185R a reliable choice for mobile 2-meter operation. Additional notable features of the FT-3185R, is Primary Memory Group Activity Monitor (PMG), and Custom Function List (CFL). The Primary Memory Group Activity Monitor (PMG) function can register up to 5 memory channels or VFO receive frequencies simply by pressing and holding the PMG key. Press the key to scan the registered frequencies and when a signal comes in on a channel other than the current channel, the transceiver will automatically receive that signal. The Custom Function List (CFL) can be personalized by registering frequently used functions (up to 9) from the 44 items of the Setup Menu. The functions may then be called up with one touch of the F-Menu key or easily selected with the DIAL knob.The FT-3185R transceiver offers enhanced audio quality with a built-in speaker delivering 3W of clear audio, specifically tuned for improved sound quality, and includes advanced features like the Super-DX function, which improves audio performance in noisy environments. Installation of the optional SPU-1 Audio Digital Signal Processing Unit (ASP) improves the audio quality of weak signals and expands the communication range (sold separately). ov: ICOM IC-V3500 VHF FM Transceivers ICOM IC-V3500 2M VHF FM Mobile Transceivers provide a solid, high‑output mobile platform with a clean, straightforward operating layout. These units deliver a full 65W of stable RF output across the 144–148 MHz transmit range and offer wideband receive coverage from 136–174MHz, ensuring flexible monitoring across the VHF spectrum.
